```{=html}
<style>
  /* Maximize width with minimal margins */
  body {
    padding: 1% 2%;
    max-width: 100%;
  }
  #title-block-header {
    margin-bottom: 20px;
  }
  
  /* Light Mode Palette (Default Flatly-compatible) */
  :root, body.quarto-light {
    --tbl-bg: #ffffff;
    --tbl-text: #333333;
    --tbl-border: #dfe2e5;
    --tbl-stripe: #f6f8fa;
    --tbl-highlight: #e6f2ff;
    --tbl-details-bg: #fafbfc;
    --tbl-accent: #0366d6;
  }
  
  /* Dark Mode Palette (One Dark Pro / Aion Theme) */
  html[data-bs-theme="dark"], 
  body[data-bs-theme="dark"], 
  body.quarto-dark {
    --tbl-bg: #282c34;
    --tbl-text: #abb2bf;
    --tbl-border: #181a1f;
    --tbl-stripe: #2c313a;
    --tbl-highlight: #323842;
    --tbl-details-bg: #21252b;
    --tbl-accent: #61afef;
    background-color: var(--tbl-bg);
  }
  
  /* Fix reactable details row background bleed */
  .rt-tr-details {
    background-color: var(--tbl-details-bg) !important;
  }

  /* Link hover styling */
  a.bold-link:hover {
    filter: brightness(1.2);
    text-decoration: underline !important;
  }

    /* Matrix Scroll Formatting */
  .matrix-wrapper {
    overflow-x: auto;
    overflow-y: visible; /* Prevents nested vertical scrollbars */
    width: 100%;
    margin-top: 15px;
  }
  
  .metric-selector {
    padding: 8px 12px;
    font-size: 14px;
    border: 1px solid var(--tbl-border);
    border-radius: 4px;
    background-color: var(--tbl-bg);
    color: var(--tbl-text);
    margin-bottom: 10px;
  }
  #overview-table .rt-tr-group:hover .rt-tr,
  #overview-table .rt-tr:hover > .rt-td {
    background-color: var(--tbl-highlight) !important;
  }

  .rt-filter,
  input.rt-filter {
    background-color: var(--tbl-bg) !important;
    color: var(--tbl-text) !important;
    border: 1px solid var(--tbl-border) !important;
    border-radius: 4px !important;
    font-size: 12px !important;
  }

  .rt-filter:focus,
  input.rt-filter:focus {
    outline: none !important;
    border-color: var(--tbl-accent) !important;
  }
</style>
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
# Map params to the variables expected by the partials
bold_files <- params$bold_input
blast_files <- params$blast_input
fasta_files <- params$fasta_input

# Theme needed for all reactable partials
dynamic_theme <- reactable::reactableTheme(
  color = "var(--tbl-text)", backgroundColor = "var(--tbl-bg)",
  borderColor = "var(--tbl-border)", stripedColor = "var(--tbl-stripe)",
  highlightColor = "var(--tbl-highlight)", cellPadding = "8px 12px"
)
```

```{r extra_reports_load}
#| echo: false
extra_reports_list <- list()
if (!is.null(params$extra_reports_path) && nzchar(params$extra_reports_path) && file.exists(params$extra_reports_path)) {
    extra_reports_list <- readRDS(params$extra_reports_path)
}
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (length(extra_reports_list) > 0) {
    for (idx in seq_along(extra_reports_list)) {
        rep_obj <- extra_reports_list[[idx]]
        cat(sprintf("\n## %s\n\n", rep_obj@title))
        widget <- rep_obj@render_fn(rep_obj@data, dynamic_theme)
        print(htmltools::tagList(widget))
        cat("\n")
    }
}
```
